facts.fact: The Somalia ICT Survey 2023 found internet access of 22.7% in rural areas and 47.1% in urban areas, per the Ministry of Communications and Technology's policy document.

The Ministry of Communications and Technology's Digital Inclusion Policy recommends improving broadband connectivity with priority to unserved and underserved areas, with an implementation roadmap budgeted at about $32 million over five years.
The policy document says the absence of government intervention in expanding access to underserved areas means the digital divide remains high in rural areas.
